content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Pensacola

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the prerequisites. Gather your project records and educational documentation now—you'll need them for your formal application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our Pensacola-based instructors deliver interactive sessions aligned to PMI's current exam content outline. You'll earn the 35 contact hours required by PMI and receive your training certificate upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your formal PMP application through PMI's credential system. Document your project-management experience, education, and training completion. Pay the examination fee to activate your application and secure your exam eligibility notice from PMI.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a PMI-approved testing center in Pensacola or online. On exam day, demonstrate your mastery of project-management domains and earn your PMP credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or publications. Renew your credential before expiration to stay current and demonstrate your commitment to professional excellence.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
